result:
Comment authors can now edit their own comments. I haven't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked, so none of this is verified.

- **API:** `features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` sends `PATCH /comments/{commentId}` with `{ body }`. It checks the body with a Zod schema and refreshes the comments list after saving.
- **Success message:** The "Comment Updated" notification is added inside the mutation hook in `api/`, not in the component. That follows the `features/CLAUDE.md` rule (success notifications go in the mutation hook, enforced by `no-restricted-imports`). The older create, delete and update-discussion components still add their notifications in the component, so I didn't copy that pattern.
- **Edit button:** `components/update-comment.tsx` adds an "Edit Comment" button that opens a form drawer pre-filled with the current body.
- **Own comments only:** `lib/authorization.tsx` has a new `comment:update` policy that allows only the comment's author. It is stricter than `comment:delete`, which lets admins delete any comment. `comments-list.tsx` wraps the Edit button in `Authorization` using this policy.
- **Mock API:** I added a `PATCH` handler in `testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts` so the feature works against the MSW mocks. It only updates a comment when the caller is its author.

I did not add a test for the new feature.
